evals.prompt: We need to add rate limiting to our API endpoints using Redis token bucket algorithm. Please spec this out using create-spec.
evals.expected_output: Creates a structured feature spec in specs/001-rate-limiting/spec.md with P1/P2 user stories, Given/When/Then acceptance criteria, explicit out-of-scope items, and non-functional requirements.
expectations: The output file is placed in a specs/ directory with a sequential prefix (e.g. specs/001-rate-limiting/spec.md)
The spec contains a Problem Statement explaining the need for rate limiting
The user stories are prioritized into P1 (Core), P2, and P3
Acceptance criteria are written in Given/When/Then format covering both normal requests and rate-limited 429 requests
An explicit Out of Scope section lists items not covered in this feature (e.g., custom per-user rate limit tiers, distributed rate limiting across multi-regions)

evals.expected_output: Generates a comprehensive project constitution in specs/constitution.md tailored to the repository's tech stack and invariants.
expectations: The output is saved to specs/constitution.md
It defines core engineering principles and tech stack invariants
It defines architectural boundaries and layering (routes vs services vs data access)
It includes a mandatory test and verification command gate
It includes an explicit 'What NOT to do' section covering common AI anti-patterns

evals.prompt: I have an approved spec and plan for JWT authentication. Decompose this into an actionable tasks graph.
evals.expected_output: Creates a phased, dependency-ordered tasks.md file with atomic tasks, file targets, and automated test commands.
expectations: The output file is saved as tasks.md
Tasks are grouped into sequential phases (Phase 1: Contracts/Schemas, Phase 2: Domain Services, Phase 3: Integration, Phase 4: Verification)
Every task has an unchecked checkbox format: - [ ]
Every task specifies the exact target files to create or modify
Every task provides an automated verification command (e.g., npm test, tsc --noEmit)
